scenarios.title: More Than Meets the Eye allows casting the card converted for its own cost

setup.notes: Goldbug, Humanity's Ally costs {1}{W}{U} and has More Than Meets the Eye {W}{U}. Evaluated in A's main phase with an empty stack.

decisions: No action is taken; the engine evaluates whether A can cast Goldbug, Humanity's Ally face up and converted.

variants.label: two_lands
variants.expected: Casting converted for {W}{U} is legal (can_play true). Casting face up for {1}{W}{U} is not legal. If cast converted, it enters as Goldbug, Scrappy Scout.

variants.label: no_blue
variants.delta: A controls Plains and Plains instead of Plains and Island.
variants.expected: Neither casting is legal: the converted cost {W}{U} needs blue mana, and so does the face-up cost.

variants.label: three_lands
variants.delta: A controls Plains, Island and Plains.
variants.expected: Both castings are legal: converted for {W}{U} and face up for {1}{W}{U}.
